Bike Mechanic - Amsterdam (Warehouse) 
Job Description 
 What you will do 
Ready to join Team Warehouse and to keep our blue wheels turning? 
At Swapfiets , we're on a mission to make biking the easy, sustainable choice for everyone. We keep our members on the go by providing a high-quality ride including free check-ups and repairs. Joining us means becoming part of this purposeful mission, and working alongside a great team in a fast-paced, fun environment to make it happen! 
As a bike mechanic at Swapfiets you are an essential part of the growth and continuity of Swapfiets. In this role you will repair all of our original and e-bikes without supervision. You are the expert in making sure our bikes are roadworthy and safe. Besides that, you will also make sure we deliver the Swapfiets quality day in, day out. 
How you pedal us forward! - 
You will be responsible for repairing our pedal bikes and our E-bikes with no supervision needed; - 
You will repair E-Bikes and pedal bikes and make them roadworthy; - 
You will ensure the Bikes' product and repair data is properly captured and up to date in repair database; - 
You will be handling special case repairs (in use, double frame numbers, founds, missings, special brokens that require documentation for insurance/police); - 
You will organize broken inflow and pre-organizing of the bikes (Triage); - 
We will make sure that you learn how to work in a safe way (safety is everyone's responsibility). 
The gear you need! - 
You have elementary knowledge about e-bikes and pedal bikes (cars or anything related can also be of help); - 
You have an affinity with cycling, mobility, sustainability and service; - 
Understand and speak English and/or Dutch; - 
Whether working independently or as part of a team, you always work successfully!;

Your own Swapfiets (lease); -
